3605-4753-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enters as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

628-1894-2018.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability
Repeat

586-4790-7824.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Gix that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-3668.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

475-1274-3197-3263.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-3197-3263.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

147-6797-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-6797-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

856-3698-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Grinding Station and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4460-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

2281-2921-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2438-4027-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Glint Hawk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Glint Hawk enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Glint Hawk.
Repeat.
2438-4027-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

3490-3755-4785-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-4785-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3375-3532-3594-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

527-725-4050-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-725-4050-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Selvala.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {1}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Selvala.
Repeat.

338-4186-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-5789.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-4862-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4862-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1742-4798-6462.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
1742-4798-6462.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

618-1938-2438.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1339-2034-5185-5361.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier is a copy of The Locust God.
1339-2034-5185-5361.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and Auton Soldier each trigger twice.
Resolve each of the Auton Soldier and The Locust God triggers, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

1069-2457-4885-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-4885-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

1987-3120-4125.notablePrerequisites:
Mindsplice Apparatus has at least two oil counters on it.
You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
1987-3120-4125.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanent.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

678-2929-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You have an enchantment creature card in hand.
You control at least six enchantments.
You have enough mana to cast the enchantment creature.
678-2929-5256.description:
Cast the enchantment creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Composer of Spring triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the enchantment creature.
When the enchantment creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the enchantment creature to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 3, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger from step 2, putting the enchantment creature onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4-933-3258.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows either from your hand or from exile by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Hoarding Broodlord.
When Hoarding Broodlord enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.

914-1170-3130-4074-4719.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
914-1170-3130-4074-4719.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Anarchist.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Anarchist.
The Anarchist token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it, dealing four damage to up to two targets.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Anarchist and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

888-1173-3571-5261.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{R} on your first turn, with {2} available on each extra turn
888-1173-3571-5261.description:
Cast Isochron Scepter by paying {2}.
Isochron Scepter enters the battlefield, triggering its imprint ability.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying Isochron Scepter's trigger.
Resolve both Isochron Scepter triggers, exiling Trickbind and Final Fortune from your hand.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of the end step during your extra turn, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding prioirty, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Trickbind and Final Fortune without paying their mana cost.
Resolve Trickbind, countering Final Fortune's trigger from step 8.
Repeat from step 6.

1170-2016-2241-3835.description:
Activate Dire Mimic's first ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Dire Mimic from your graveyard using Serra Paragon's ability by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Serra Paragon.
Activate Dire Mimic's first ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Dire Mimic leaves the battlefield, triggering its ability.
In response, repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, resolve all Dire Mimic abilities, causing you to exile it from your graveyard if it's in your graveyard and gain infinite life.

618-2438-2857.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Adarkar Valkyrie with haste.
Tap the Adarkar Valkyrie token targeting Kiki-Jiki.
Sacrifice Kiki-Jiki to Carrion Feeder to put a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Adarkar Valkyrie Returns Kiki-Jiki to the battlefield.
Repeat.
